reviews.text: I came to see Dean with my Australian labradoodle puppy when she was 14 weeks old. Dean is an absolute guru with dogs. His approach is kind and rationale. He really listens to you and provides advice that is totally tailored to you and your dog. I was really nervous about training and ‘getting it right’, but Dean gave me the tools my dog and I needed, and it made it a really fun, enjoyable and bonding experience. Meeting up with Dean on Hampstead Heath for our sessions became the highlight of our week! She is really good on recall, loose lead walking, doesn’t resource guard (which the breed is prone to), all of which is credit to Dean. Couldn’t recommend highly enough.

Dean is an excellent trainer: he knows dogs and he knows people. As a first time dog owner he made a home visit early on for me to start to learn how to forge a strong relationship with my dog, and build healthy behaviours. We also met him on Hampstead Heath for a few dog walks and over the past 18 months we have consulted a few times to work on any issues and challenges along the way. My dog Monty is very well socialised with other dogs, children and babies, I can take him anywhere with complete ease and confidence. His recall, lead walking and general behaviours are always complimented by other dog owners and I owe this to Dean. Essentially he has given me the confidence to raise a healthy and happy dog, within only a few sessions. I could not recommend him more highly. And if you walk with him on Hampstead Heath you will quickly realise how many dogs and dog owners there absolutely love him and value his time and expertise!

Dean helped me to understand my dog’s behaviour and to appreciate what is actually a problem and what isn’t. The best trainers don’t just train dogs, they train owners. That is what Dean does. He understands both dogs and people and helped me to regain my confidence in Juno and to strengthen my relationship with her. He’s also a really nice guy. It was a pleasure to work with him.

Dean is such a wonderful guy- my two Poms and I met him for a session in January to work with my 1 year old Pom and I on improving our communication. Dean quickly earned both of my boys trust, and was able to help me learn how to help set my youngest up for success by being clear about what was “good” behaviour. He also taught me the “gold, silver, bronze” ways for teaching my dogs how to switch to other positive behavior when they start to do things I don’t want (pulling on lead, jumping up, etc.). I was so impressed with our progress in just one session and have been able to follow through with it to be the very happy result for my Poms and I. We also have been working on our “homework” and know he’s a text away if we need support. Five stars!

My very dog reactive Korean Jindo rescue and I had a session with Dean in early January.  We were very stuck with getting our dog to manage seeing and passing other dogs without turning into a swirling dervish, despite watching many videos on positive reinforcement and having previously engaged other dog trainers. Dean was non-judgemental about the extreme reaction to dogs and showed me how to recognise and reinforce positive behaviour.  It is the first time that I feel we have received practical advice on how to move forward with this very stressful issue and even though it is only 4 days since the training, our dog is able to look at me when he sees a dog at a distance, with a bit of whining, and also take a treat. I will definitely return to Dean once we have made significant progress, hopefully in a few months. I highly recommend him as a caring and experienced trainer.

Dean is a wonderful dog trainer. He listens to your and your dogs needs and takes the time to explain everything in digestible terms. He helped me understand my dog better and gave me the confidence a dog owner should have (+ Sapphire also loves him). Sapphire and I highly recommend him to anyone who wants to form a deeper bond and understanding of their dog.

Have had a couple of great sessions with Dean. Can highly recommend. Needed help on a few things with a puppy, particularly recall. He explained a really clear and simple method to use and could see a big difference after just a couple of walks. He's a really nice bloke and the sessions are fun, interesting and the dogs seem to love them.

Have seen Dean a few times now and it’s the best money I’ve spent on my dog. Dean distills your dogs behaviour in way that just makes you think “duh”. We stuck with Dean because he uses positive reinforcement rather than nasty shock collars or other negative reinforcement methods. Beside our dog being infatuated with Dean (because he always gives him treats) Dean equips you with the tools and knowledge you need to be able to come away from the session and continue training your dog yourself.

Couldn’t recommend Dean enough!

From the first moment I connected with Dean, I felt completely reassured. As a first-time dog mum, I had all the usual concerns—and a few more, given my dog’s health issues and sensitive nature ( Italian greyhound!) .

Dean was patient, calm, and incredibly knowledgeable, instantly putting both me and Leo at ease.

I’ll never forget that moment when we first tried removing the lead—I honestly felt my heart drop—but Dean’s calm and experienced guidance made it such a positive and controlled experience. He knew exactly when Leo was ready and supported us both through the process.

Dean is an absolute wealth of knowledge when it comes to dogs (plus life in general). His understanding of behaviour, especially for sensitive breeds like mine, is exceptional. Dean explains things in a way that’s clear, supportive, and never overwhelming, which was exactly what I needed.

We both left the session with so much more confidence, and Dean made sure we had a toolkit of practical tips to continue progress at home.

I only wish I had started sessions with Dean earlier—the difference he made, even after one session, was huge. Leo responded so well to him, and I felt safe and supported throughout.

I can’t recommend Dean highly enough for anyone looking for not just a trainer, but someone who truly understands dogs and helps you understand them too.

Thank you, Dean!

After having one session with Dean and trying other trainers, I can honestly say this was a complete rip-off.

He charged us £150 for 1 hour and 30 minutes, met us near Hampstead Heath, and didn’t provide a proper environment for the session. Instead, we randomly walked through different streets and hid behind cars whenever my dog saw other dogs — that was his idea of training.

I don’t mind paying £150 for quality service, but this was pathetic. Most of the time he just talked — much of it irrelevant — and offered no real value. To make matters worse, he took cash in hand and didn’t even provide a receipt. Completely unprofessional.

Since then, I’ve found other dog trainers who charge far more reasonable prices, provide proper training environments, and handle things professionally with paperwork — unlike Dean and his company.

Dean is an absolute ace and our two sessions with him have already had such a positive effect on our little schnauzer. We have a seven month old puppy who barks at every dog she meets. He understood right away what she needed and what we should focus on.  With his guidance we took her off lead for the first time on the heath and it was so fun and transformative. I can already see the difference in her demeanor with other dogs and I can report that my own stress levels have gone down dramatically!  Dean's approach is both pragmatic and big hearted, for dog and owner.  He has my highest recommendation!

Dean was a fantastic trainer. I’ve had trainers in the past but Dean was highly skilled, knowledgable and professional. He explained things thoroughly and really helped me to understand how to get the best out of my dog and the psychology behind it. I saw improvements in my dogs behaviour instantly, which was amazing. I would highly recommend him, I know I’ll be using his services again. Super nice bloke too.

Wonderful experience!! I have a 3-year-old Pomeranian who’s never been great on or off the lead — it often felt like he was walking me! He also didn’t respond to recalls and got distracted by just about everything. After just one session with Dean, all of that changed. My Pom is now walking with me on the lead and even following me off-lead. I’m genuinely amazed by the transformation.

We’ve done puppy classes before, but I never felt motivated — all the worksheets and rigid exercises just didn’t click for us. What I love about Dean’s teaching is that it’s built around what actually works for my dog and me. It’s about creating synergy. His approach also lets the dog express choice and naturally improves the dynamic between us, rather than relying on strict commands or discipline. I really appreciate this more ‘laissez-faire’ style of parenting — it feels so much more aligned with how I want to raise my dog.

The best things are simple — but few can explain them simply. Dean is one of those rare people who not only explains things clearly and simply, but also brings them to life with powerful results. And the way he understands and connects with animals on such a deep, intuitive, and psychological level is truly beautiful.

So don’t hesitate to book a class with Dean. He’s simply the best — and can save you a lot of frustration and headaches!

Dean has been absolutely incredible. We picked up our dachshund puppy at 4 months old, she wasn’t very well socialised and therefore this caused a lot of anxiety and reactivity.

Dean gave us the confidence to not be embarrassed of her barking and explained how she was scared and stressed. His support and advice had an immediate effect. After 3 sessions with Dean and training in our own time we have found our Daxie has come on leaps and bounds. She’s comfortable around other dogs and people and enjoys every walk.

Dean trains both the owner and the dog by showing us techniques which put the dog in the best position for success. There’s so much conflicting information on the internet and it’s so refreshing to have methods which actually work and have a long lasting effect.

He's also a great laugh and makes it easy to spend time with in the sessions! Great analogies guaranteed.

I can't say enough good things about Dean, we've had three sessions with him and our golden retriever puppy, and I'm so grateful for the value he's brought to our relationship with our dog. We love our dog, she's perfect for us and people are always commenting on how well behaved she is especially for her age.

Dean is incredibly experienced and knowledgeable and showed us how to communicate with our puppy, and it's easy to see his fully positive methods in action - our dog responds so well to his kind and fun philosophy and it has become the backbone of our approach to training.

The first session was at 9 weeks, when we felt totally overwhelmed as first time dog owners, Dean was equal parts reassuring, empathetic and pragmatic. I really appreciated that he advised on how to maintain our human needs alongside giving our pup the best care she deserves. We trained with him again at 12 weeks for our first walk, then again at 7 months for further life skills. We covered everything - biting, jumping, toilet training, crate training, recall, leash walking, leave it & a lot more.

Dean's a lovely and approachable person who provides invaluable over-the-phone support following each session, super understanding of any struggles we're having and guided me through my puppy blues. I really think he can greatly help any dog guardian no matter what stage they're at, to feel confident and closely bonded. Highly recommend, obviously!

Having never owned a dog (or even a pet!) before, we decided to start on the right foot and booked two 1-2-1 sessions with Dean, and it was hands down the best decision we made as dog owners. Dean’s knowledge is incredible, and his warm, friendly approach put both us and our pup at ease.

Beyond the basics—potty training, recall, and general obedience—he’s a fountain of wisdom for all sorts of niche dog dilemmas, from car phobia to preparing a pup for the arrival of a human baby. He’s also always available for fine-tuning and ongoing questions, which has been invaluable.

Everyone comments on how well-behaved our Maltipoo is, and we owe that entirely to Dean. If you want a stress-free dog ownership experience, don’t hesitate—book with him!

Working with Dean was - an absolute pleasure. His intuition with dogs and people is unmatched. He navigated our dog Mighty, who is a rescue, with ease, calmness, and trust. He got our untrained pup off lead in 4 weeks, which seemed a real challenge until we met Dean. He was kind enough to remain a resource as we continued to train. He was our dog's first UK friend after a move abroad from the US. I could not recommend him more.

Dean is a legend. We recently moved to Hampstead from the States with our rescue pup and were desperate to have him learn recall so he could run off lead in the Heath. Dean got him there in four weeks! He’s talented, kind, and an absolute pleasure to work with.

Honestly it’s nothing short of miraculous  …. All I can say is, my wildest dreams have come true. My reactive GSD who was never off lead because she chased EVERTHING is no longer reactive and she’s off lead most of the time now. Dean was a key part in getting her to where we are now - a chilled out, happy dog.

Dean has been a lifesaver for us! Having tried a few different trainers in the area I can safely say that Dean is the best. Within one session our (then) 3 month old pup was walking off lead and returning when called. He has shown us how to handle lots of challenging situations with her, and set her (and us) for a happy and safe life with us. I cannot recommend him enough.

From no recall to excellent recall in 20 mins. Nellie our 16 month old Frenchie, is now so much happier, to be exploring off lead and burning up her youthful energy. It was no 'one off' fluke, we have taken her out off lead, multiple times since, and she remains fully obedient.  We are very happy to recommend Dean.

Dean has been excellent - he has been seeing our Scottish terrier puppy since he was 3 months old and couldn’t have set him up for a better start. Equal parts reassuring and informative, our sessions with Dean always end with renewed tools and inspiration for more training. Highly recommend for all new dog owners!

Dean has been a real god send for us - we’ve had many trainers since we brought home our cockapoo puppy Maui 2 years ago but none have been as practical as Dean. He has showed us actual useful tips that have brought on Maui’s training leaps and bounds! We are so grateful to Dean
The 90 minutes we spent with Dean were more than 10,000 times as useful as the 6-week dog training course we took previously.

Dean has been helping me train my golden retriever puppy for the past 6 months, since she was just 5 months old. I cannot recommend him enough! We’ve focused on loose lead walking and preventing resource guarding (my pup is somewhat prone to this), and the progress we’ve seen has been incredible.  I feel so much more confident training her thanks to Dean. Highly recommend!!

Booked sessions with Dean to help with reducing how much my cockapoo Buddy would react to other dogs. After just two sessions I was able to let Buddy wonder around freely and interact with dogs, showing no reaction. We've got things to …

When we got our first border terrier, we realized we needed some help to properly train him. Dean’s guidance provided us and our pup with the structure he needed, and after one session, we felt more comfortable on our dog walks than in the …

Dean has been an absolute hero helping us with Flash, and now Dina who has recently joined our family. His methods help the human to properly understand what is going on in a dog’s mind and be able to apply extremely simple techniques to …
Spent a great 90mins with Dean and my dog Perdy yesterday on the Heath. Absolutely fantastic
